values.summary: Execute the smallest proving validation DAG.

lanes.proof_role: Prove current Sprint 5 membership, four-child operative closeout scope, WP-20 release-tail handoff, bind-safe child contracts, dependency gates, publication boundaries, umbrella ownership, and digest-bound live GitHub provenance.
lanes.defer_reason: The contract checks are deterministic over retained inputs, but snapshot freshness depends on wall-clock time and observed GitHub state.

values.failure_policy: Fail closed on overlapping ownership, unmet serial gates, missing child readiness, or unsupported completion claims.
